title: Fix freezed orphan files — add @freezed annotation or delete stale .freezed.dart
objective: Audit every *.freezed.dart file under lib/ and either (a) confirm its parent source file declares the matching @freezed annotation, or (b) delete the orphan generated file when no parent annotation exists. No file may keep a .freezed.dart sibling without a corresponding @freezed-decorated class.
description: Running `find lib -name '*.freezed.dart'` produces 12 files. For each one, find the sibling `.dart` source file and confirm it contains `@freezed`. Per the session context for widget-native-migration, every .freezed.dart sibling is expected to have a parent. The fix is mechanical: for each orphan (sibling exists but no @freezed annotation), inspect why — common causes are (1) the source file used to declare @freezed but the annotation was removed during a refactor; the file should either be re-annotated OR the orphan deleted; (2) the source file is the data layer's hand-written mixin that imports the .freezed.dart sibling — in this case no annotation is needed and the file is correct, no action required. The subtask is an audit-and-clean pass.

reference_files.reason: M3 may delete this whole directory — if so, the sibling .freezed.dart goes with it. Otherwise this file MUST declare @freezed (it currently imports freezed_annotation but does NOT declare @freezed) — investigate: either add the annotation + regenerate, or delete the orphan .freezed.dart.
Same audit — confirm @freezed is on a state class declared here, OR on profile_state.dart which lives next to it.

audit_procedure: For every directory that contains a .freezed.dart file, run `rg -n '@freezed' <sibling>.dart <state_file>.dart`. If exactly one file in the directory declares @freezed, the directory is healthy. If zero files declare it, delete the .freezed.dart sibling AND its matching .g.dart sibling. If two files declare it, that is also a bug (one should not be freezed) — fix by removing the annotation from the wrong file and regenerating.
acceptance_criteria: Every .freezed.dart file under lib/ has a sibling source file that declares @freezed
No orphan .freezed.dart files survive (no file in lib/ is a generated freezed mixin without a parent @freezed class)
If audit found no orphans: this subtask is a no-op, recorded as completed
If audit found orphans: they are either fixed (re-add @freezed) or deleted (along with their .g.dart siblings)
flutter analyze lib/ returns no errors
build_runner regeneration produces no further diff (i.e. the audit and cleanup are consistent with what build_runner would produce)

grep_evidence: for every .freezed.dart file under lib/, the sibling source file MUST contain a line matching `^@freezed`
`find lib -name '*.freezed.dart' | wc -l` equals the number of `@freezed` annotations found by `rg -nc '@freezed' lib/` (plus 0 for any hand-written mixins that don't @freezed)

no_op_outside_scope: Do not regenerate any other freezed file. Do not change existing @freezed declarations. Do not introduce new freezed classes.
